text:
ajackson: Heads up — deploy-bot failed to promote canary to stable, blocking the cut. @tlee can you take a look? deploy logs below.

deploy-bot: Promotion job #672 FAILED
```
ERROR: failed to acquire artifact upload lease: timeout after 120s
upload to gs://redwood-artifacts/canary/sha-abc123.tar: lease acquire failed
Retries exhausted (4 attempts)
```

ci-bot: Observed spike in remote-cache lease contention starting 03:12 UTC, pod gpu-cache-0 restarted 03:11 with OOM. Upload retries across runners increased x10.

tlee: On it. Initial hunch: cache leader flapped and left stale lock holders. Pulling logs: `kubectl logs gpu-cache-0 -n infra | tail -n 200`.

sre-josh: Marking this release as HOLD. We shouldn't promote while artifact writes are erroring — risk of partial or corrupted canary.

maria: Agreed. Hold the cut. Options: rollback to previous stable (v1.12.3) or pin digest and manually promote. Thoughts?

ajackson: I prefer pinning digest to keep last known-good while infra fixes cache. Less churn than full rollback. Who can do manual promote?

tlee: I can pin and promote manually. Manual steps: 
1) confirm v1.12.3 digest `sha256:deadbeef`
2) trigger deploy-bot with `--force-digest=sha256:deadbeef`
3) watch canary for 15m; abort on any latency/error spike > 5%

deploy-bot: Manual promotion request queued by @tlee: job #673 pending.

ci-bot: Additional telemetry: artifact-registry returning 429s and backoffs across builders. Suggest reducing concurrent uploads from 8 -> 2 and enable exponential backoff jitter.

sre-josh: I'll own the hold/watch. We'll also run a quick check for stale leases and kill any abandoned holders. Planning short RCA after stabilization.

maria: Change window approved for manual promote. @ajackson update release notes to mention manual pin and follow-up RCA.

ajackson: Will update release notes and open infra ticket for lease cleanup + leader resilience.

tlee: Performed manual promote; canary is up and serving. 12m healthy so far. Metrics: p50/p95 latency within SLO, error rate 0.2%.

sre-josh: Nice. Keeping hold until 15m mark then clear. Also creating a runbook entry for "artifact lease stall".

action items:
- tlee: manual promote + verify (done, monitor)
- sre-josh: root cause + runbook for lease cleanup
- infra: implement lease cleanup job and reduce upload concurrency defaults
- ajackson: update release notes + create follow-up ticket

maria: Thanks all :thumbsup:
